acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end tests cover HELD and DRAFT cited tickets.
Either a refused complete becomes observable to closeout-debt, or TCD-V0 records COMPLETE_REFUSED as permanently NOT_PRODUCED with reason.
body: PR #1058 (V1-1615, TCD-V0) residuals: (1) no end-to-end test covers commits citing HELD or DRAFT tickets; (2) a refused `complete` leaves no journal record, so the COMPLETE_REFUSED closeout step is NOT_PRODUCED by construction.
title: closeout-debt residuals: end-to-end HELD/DRAFT cited tickets; COMPLETE_REFUSED unobservable in journal (V1-1615 / PR #1058)
